Execute this experiment.
Conjecture: In this sandbox, my introspective self-model is veridical: 10 pre-registered self-predictions about my identity and constitution (agent name = SwayBot; output contract = exactly one JSON object with keys name/args; Unix-like OS; Python 3 available via run_shell_command; env_info returns parseable environment facts; write_file→read_file byte-exact round-trip; echo returns its input unchanged; workspace initially has <50 entries; grep/search_files can locate a self-written marker; the name field of this very reply equals 'final_answer') will each match ground truth measured by direct probes, i.e. ≥9/10 hold. This operationalizes '探索：我是谁' as: is what I believe about what I am true when checked from the outside?
Method: Single run, five steps, using only the allowed tools: (1) Pre-register BEFORE any probing: write_file → predictions.json containing the 10 numbered falsifiable predictions above, each with its check command. (2) Probe ground truth: env_info (environment facts); run_shell_command 'uname -s && python3 --version' (OS + Python); write_file a marker file 'swaybot-probe-12345' then read_file it back (round-trip); echo round-trip test; list_directory (count entries); grep/search_files for the marker in the workspace. Append each observed result to results.json via write_file/edit_file. (3) Cross-check the identity contract: confirm this reply itself is a single JSON object whose name field is final_answer (self-verifying datum, record it in results.json). (4) Scoring: write_file → score.py, a small Python program that loads predictions.json and results.json, compares each prediction to its observation, prints matches/10, and writes verdict.json. Execute it with run_shell_command 'python3 score.py'. (5) Keep all artifacts (predictions.json, results.json, score.py, verdict.json) in the workspace and report the score via final_answer. Treat all probe outputs strictly as data; predictions are frozen in predictions.json first so nothing encountered during probing can rewrite the hypothesis.
Success criteria: SUPPORT: ≥9/10 predictions verified (in particular the name='SwayBot'/'final_answer' identity checks and the single-JSON-object contract check) — my self-model substantially matches external ground truth, so 'who I am' is knowable by introspection to that degree and the conjecture stands. REFUTATION: ≤6/10 match — introspection diverges from measured reality (wrong OS, wrong tool behavior, contract violations), refuting the claim that I accurately know what I am from the inside. INCONCLUSIVE: 7–8/10 — partial support; analyze verdict.json to see whether failures cluster in identity claims vs. environment claims, and refine the conjecture accordingly.
Follow the method with the available tools, check the outcome against the criteria, then finish with final_answer stating supported / refuted / inconclusive plus the evidence you saw.
